edits.after: Repetir «aquí todo el mundo es bienvenido» no sustituye el trato real que reciben los miembros cuando se equivocan, discrepan o temporalmente no aportan nada. La pertenencia nace de experiencias reiteradas: después de exponer razones distintas, alguien sigue respondiendo a esas razones; cuando necesito límites, no tengo que demostrar primero que los demás siguen importándome; después de cambiar, el grupo está dispuesto a conocerme de nuevo, en vez de reclamar únicamente mi versión anterior.
edits.reason: Identity verification of root-approved correction to the Chinese negation: one need not first prove that one still cares before having boundaries. Existing Spanish is accurate; root owns the English source coordinate.

edits.after: These moments tell us more than slogans do about whether values have entered the group's actual structure.
edits.reason: Clarify the comparison with slogans and avoid the ambiguous attachment of about whether.
edits.before: These moments reveal more than slogans about whether values have entered the group's actual structure.

edits.after: They cannot simply throw risks at the group while refusing to say what they will take on; nor, because their view was not adopted, can they declare every later problem something they foresaw. Dissent is participation, not a way to stand permanently outside the consequences and claim exemption from responsibility.
edits.reason: Naturalize exemption outside the outcome; preserve both obligations of dissenters and their participation in consequences.
edits.before: They cannot simply throw risks at the group while refusing to say what they will take on; nor, because their view was not adopted, can they declare every later problem something they foresaw. Dissent is participation, not a permanent exemption from responsibility outside the outcome.

edits.after: No puede limitarse a arrojar riesgos al grupo y negarse a explicar qué está dispuesto a asumir; tampoco puede declarar que había previsto todos los problemas posteriores solo porque no se aceptó su propuesta. Discrepar es participar, no una forma de quedar siempre al margen de los resultados y eximirse de responsabilidad.
edits.reason: Naturalize the full concluding contrast between participation and claiming immunity from consequences.
edits.before: No puede limitarse a arrojar riesgos al grupo y negarse a explicar qué está dispuesto a asumir; tampoco puede declarar que había previsto todos los problemas posteriores solo porque no se aceptó su propuesta. Discrepar es participar, no eximirse para siempre quedando fuera de los resultados.

edits.after: If leaving is always interpreted as betrayal and once-close members are comprehensively disparaged after departure, those who remain will know that the respect they receive is conditional too. They stay not only because they agree, but also because they fear losing their former identity and relationships.
edits.reason: Clarify that conditional respect is respect received by remaining members, not respect they give others.
edits.before: If leaving is always interpreted as betrayal and once-close members are comprehensively disparaged after departure, those who remain will know that their own respect is conditional too. They stay not only because they agree, but also because they fear losing their former identity and relationships.

edits.after: Dos personas que apenas se conocen descubren que hay una persona que no le gusta a ninguno de los dos.
edits.reason: Remove ambiguity between disliking the same person and merely not liking the same person as each other.
edits.before: Dos personas que apenas se conocen descubren que no les gusta la misma persona.

edits.after: Ofrece un objetivo claro y elimina provisionalmente nuestras diferencias. Mientras hablemos de «lo que tiene de malo esa persona», no tenemos que responder qué valora de verdad cada uno ni afrontar que nuestra propia relación aún está por construir.
edits.reason: 不必 is need not, not should not; restore avoidance of substantive questions rather than an injunction not to answer them.
